1: The Thing in the Hole

Chum

People of Mawinaken flee the overrun town to escape the rapidly approaching undead.
The Lady Birders of Nepa
The survivors hole up at a department store, the only place safe from the undead.

The survivors use a department store as a fortress as threats start to grow from within.
To Anyone Who Can Hear My Voice
The fortress of Paymart comes under siege as survivors are forced to fight for their lives or flee.

Choke on 'Em!
